docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,379.67 FILED BY MARINCOVICH, LOUIE AS TO DEFENDANT HABEGGER, LARRY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-01-2016 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED SEP-14-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT HABEGGER, LARRY

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-01-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-01-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: J.BERTELSEN. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-01-2016 - JUDGMENT.
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JAN-03-2017 ORDERED DESTROYED

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MARINCOVICH, LOUIE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT HABEGGER, LARRY PLAINTIFF ENTERED INTO AN ORAL AGREEMENT WITH DEFENDANT, A PROFESSIONAL EDITOR, TO REVIEW AND EDIT PLAINTIFF'S MANUSCRIPT AUTOBIOGRAPHY. THE DEFENDANT PERFORMED UNDER THE AGREEMENT AND BILLED PLAINTIFF AT THE HOURLY RATE OF $100.00 FOR A TOTAL OF $5,379.67, WHICH PLAINTIFF PAID. PLAINTIFF IS DISSATISFIED WITH THE RESULT OF DEFENDANT'S WORK WHICH WAS NOT SHOWN BY THE EVIDENCE TO BE IN BREACH OF THE ORAL AGREEMENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
